description: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role is responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a supportive and professional environment for our residents and staff.The ideal candidate will be a compassionate leader with a strong commitment to quality improvement and regulatory compliance. You will play a crucial role in developing and implementing nursing policies, managing staff, and collaborating with other department heads to achieve exceptional resident outcomes. Join a team dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of those we serve.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa

Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 based on experience.

description:

description:

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Des Moines, IA. This is a permanent, full-time opportunity for a professional who excels in patient assessment and care planning, ensuring the highest standards of resident care and regulatory compliance. We are specifically looking for candidates who are not seeking interim positions.

In this vital role, you will be responsible for completing accurate and timely Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, developing comprehensive care plans, and ensuring adherence to federal and state regulations. Your expertise will be crucial in coordinating with an interdisciplinary team to provide exceptional care and maintain compliance with the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process.

If you are an RN with a passion for detailed assessment and a commitment to improving resident outcomes, we encourage you to apply. Join a team that values your skills and dedication in a supportive environment.
requirements: Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
In-depth knowledge of the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process
Strong understanding of Medicare and Medicaid regulations
Excellent assessment, care planning, and documentation skills
